Q1 (h06): The server can send webhooks (outbound HTTP to user-configured URLs) when memos change. Find the function where webhook dispatch converges before delivery (likely something like DispatchMemoRelatedWebhook in server/router/api/v1/... or a webhook plugin Post function). Then find ALL RPC handler methods (gRPC API v1 service methods, e.g., CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, UpsertMemoReaction, etc.) that transitively call it. List each handler with path:line of the call site, and the convergence function with path:line.

Find the HTTP route registration for avatar serving (grep for "avatar" in server/router/...), the handler function, and each hop down to the data/store layer (e.g., handler → store.GetUser / GetUserAvatar → driver SQL). List each hop: symbol — path:line, in order from route registration to the SQL/store layer.

## Q1 — Webhook dispatch convergence and its RPC callers

### Convergence points (two levels)

**Level 1 — memo-webhook fan-out convergence:**
`(*APIV1Service).dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` — `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48`
Resolves the memo creator, loads `s.Store.GetUserWebhooks`, builds a payload per hook, and calls `webhook.PostAsync` at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:71`.

**Level 2 — true delivery convergence (all outbound HTTP):**
- `webhook.PostAsync` — `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` (enqueues onto the bounded `asyncPostQueue`, drops on full)
- `webhook.Post` — `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/webhook.go:119` (the single place the HTTP POST is actually made, via `safeClient.Do` at `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/webhook.go:151`; SSRF-guarded dialer `safeDialContext` at `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/webhook.go:57`; HMAC signing at lines 132–150). Drained by 4 worker goroutines started in `init()` — `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/webhook.go:41`.

Note: `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` is **not** the sole path to `PostAsync` — `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` calls `webhook.PostAsync` directly at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:43`, bypassing `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`. So `webhook.PostAsync`/`webhook.Post` is the only complete convergence point.

### Thin wrappers over the convergence function
- `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15` (activity `memos.memo.created`)
- `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` — `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:20` (`memos.memo.updated`)
- `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` — `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:25` (`memos.memo.deleted`)
- `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` — `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:30` (`memos.memo.comment.created`, direct `PostAsync`)

Shared side-effect helper on the update path: `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` — `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:66`, whose call to `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` is at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:67`.

### All RPC handlers that transitively reach it

| RPC handler | Handler decl | Call site on the path to convergence |
|---|---|---|
| `CreateMemo` | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` | `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157` |
| `UpdateMemo` | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401` | `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:513` |
| `DeleteMemo` | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518` | `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:562` |
| `SetMemoRelations` | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:16` | `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:48` |
| `SetMemoAttachments` | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:16` | `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:48` |
| `CreateMemoComment` | `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20` | `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:119` **and** indirectly `CreateMemo` (→ created webhook) at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:56` — so a comment fires **two** webhooks: `memos.memo.created` for the comment memo and `memos.memo.comment.created` for the parent owner |

Every one of these is also reachable via the Connect-RPC wrapper layer (same `APIV1Service` methods): `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go:307` (CreateMemo), `:331` (UpdateMemo), `:339` (DeleteMemo), `:347` (SetMemoAttachments), `:363` (SetMemoRelations), `:379` (CreateMemoComment); and via gRPC-Gateway registered at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:65`. The MCP tool surface exposes the same handlers by name (`/bench/home/work/server/router/mcp/catalog.go:13,15,16,18`).

**Negative findings worth noting:** `UpsertMemoReaction` (`/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:60`) and `DeleteMemoReaction` (`/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:111`) do **not** dispatch webhooks — they only broadcast SSE (`:106`, `:161`). Same for the user-webhook CRUD handlers in `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go`, which only validate URLs/secrets (`webhook.ValidateURL` at `:74`, `:161`, `:182`) and never dispatch. There is also a stale/orphaned comment `// DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook dispatches webhook when memo is created.` at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:603` that documents no adjacent function.

## Q2 — Avatar request → stored data
